picks.what: View over the town toward the sea, autochrome (Albert Kahn Museum)
picks.why: color general view (original caption “Vue générale de Latakié”); flat-roofed old town, minarets, sea on the horizon

notes: All four candidates are Gadmer autochromes of 27 October 1921. #4 is a near-duplicate of #1. #3 (toward the northern bay, bluer sea, more trees) is a good alternative if a more colorful frame is wanted. Trim removes the plate frame and the “SYRIE • A30032” label strip on the left.
